project.name: Banksy case graph
project.description: Reviewed visual-rhetoric case graph for a limited Banksy corpus. Sources are CC-licensed Wikimedia Commons photographs; the artworks themselves are not CC-licensed.

classes.label: Visual artifact
classes.definition: An object or intervention that produces meaning through visual form.

classes.label: Street artwork
classes.definition: An artwork made for or in public space.

classes.label: Installation
classes.definition: A spatial or institutional work rather than a single image.

classes.label: Agent
classes.definition: A person or collective that acts or is attributed authorship.

classes.label: Rhetorical trope
classes.definition: A repeatable persuasive or figural strategy.

classes.label: Public site
classes.definition: A physical location with social meaning.

classes.label: Institution
classes.definition: An organisation that frames or displays art.

classes.label: Audience
classes.definition: A collective addressed by a work.

classes.label: Discourse
classes.definition: A public issue or frame of debate.

classes.label: Reception event
classes.definition: An event in which a work is received, circulated, or documented.

relation_types.label: deploys
relation_types.definition: The work uses this rhetorical trope.

relation_types.label: sitedAt
relation_types.definition: The work is situated at this site.

relation_types.label: attributedTo
relation_types.definition: The work is attributed to this artist.

relation_types.label: practises
relation_types.definition: The agent habitually uses this rhetorical trope.

relation_types.label: respondsTo
relation_types.definition: The work responds to this discourse.

relation_types.label: institutionalContext
relation_types.definition: The work is framed by this institution.

relation_types.label: appropriates
relation_types.definition: The work reuses another visual work.

relation_types.label: receptionOf
relation_types.definition: The reception event concerns this work.

attribute_types.label: year
attribute_types.definition: Year associated with the work or event.
